claims: Alexia Jayy was crowned the winner of The Voice Season 29 on April 14, 2026.
The Voice Season 29 is titled "Battle of Champions".
The Voice Season 29 took place in Spring 2026.
Alexia Jayy was a member of Team Adam Levine.
Alexia Jayy secured the victory with a final performance of Aretha Franklin’s "I Never Loved a Man (The Way I Love You)".
Adam Levine was Alexia Jayy's coach.
Adam Levine's win with Alexia Jayy is his 4th win.
Liv Ciara placed 2nd in The Voice Season 29 Finale on Team Kelly.
Lucas West placed 3rd in The Voice Season 29 Finale on Team Legend.
Mikenley Brown placed 4th in The Voice Season 29 Finale on Team Kelly.
Alexia Jayy is the first African-American female to win in The Voice's history.
Alexia Jayy's winning single is "Rent Free".
The April 2026 "Battle of Champions" finale concluded with Alexia Jayy as the winner.
